title: Valley Design System
description: A comprehensive, production-ready design system built on Tailwind CSS conventions.

hero.headline: A production-ready design system bridging design and engineering.

paragraphs: A comprehensive, production-ready design system built on Tailwind CSS conventions — delivering full component coverage, state documentation, and developer-handoff annotations across Valmont's Valley product suite.
Every token maps directly to a Tailwind class name. Every interactive component documents all six states. Every annotation was built for developer clarity — not designer satisfaction.

process.heading: Without a system, every screen is a new decision.
process.description: Valmont's Valley product suite spans enterprise web applications and field tablet tools — multiple surfaces, multiple teams, multiple engineering stacks. Without a unified design language, the same button appeared in four different sizes across six different screens.

phases.title: Inconsistency
phases.description: Same components, different sizes and colours across screens built by different teams.

phases.title: Slow Handoff
phases.description: Developers re-interpreted designs rather than implementing a named spec — introducing drift on every sprint.

phases.title: No States
phases.description: Components existed in one state — the happy path. Hover, disabled, error, and validation were built ad hoc.

applications.heading: Every component. Every state. Every size.
applications.description: A comprehensive library of production-ready UI components, each documented with full state coverage, size variants, and annotation for developer handoff.

apps.name: Inputs
apps.subtitle: Text, textarea, suffix/prefix, labeled. 4 sizes × 6 states.

keyChanges.after: Icon left/right/both configurations with consistent spacing

apps.name: Dropdown
apps.subtitle: Simple, multiselect with tags/count, grouped options, search with inline add.

keyChanges.after: Single, multi with tags/count, grouped, and search variants

apps.name: Buttons
apps.subtitle: Primary, secondary, ghost, destructive. Icon-only buttons enforce tooltip accessibility rule.

keyChanges.before: Four different button sizes across six screens
keyChanges.after: 4 variants with consistent sizing and state rules

apps.name: Selectors
apps.subtitle: Toggle, Checkbox, Radio button and Radio group.

keyChanges.after: Toggle, Checkbox, Radio button, and Radio group — all 4 states
Desktop and Mobile variants documented separately

apps.name: Dialog / Modal
apps.subtitle: Scrollable body with fixed header + footer.

keyChanges.after: Scrollable body with fixed header + footer, max height 95vh

outcome.quote: Standardized 200+ UI components into a master design system — increasing designer-to-developer handoff speed by 25% across the Valley product suite.

deliverables.title: Single Source of Truth
deliverables.description: One Figma file serves as the definitive component reference for all Valley products.

deliverables.title: 25% Faster Handoffs
deliverables.description: Named components, annotated interactions, and Tailwind-aligned tokens mean developers implement rather than interpret.

deliverables.title: Full State Coverage
deliverables.description: Every component ships with all 6 interaction states.
